title: Legal Forwarding Agreements — Schedule of Fees and Contingency Rates
content:
# Schedule of Fees and Contingency Rates

This schedule sets out, for every forwarding programme offered under the Legal Forwarding Agreements, the contingency rate and the fixed fees Ridgeline charges the creditor client on forwarded matters. Each column applies to every programme; a figure of 0.00 means the programme carries no charge of that kind.

## Fee columns defined

- **Contingency rate** — the contingency fee on collections from a forwarded matter once it is forwarded, in percent of those collections.
- **Suit fee** — the non-refundable attorney suit fee charged to the client when a suit is filed, in USD.
- **Demand letter fee** — the fee per attorney demand letter, in USD.
- **Forwarding fee** — the fee per account forwarded to an attorney, in USD.
- **Dismissal fee** — the fee when the client asks for a filed suit to be dismissed, in USD.
- **Recall-after-suit fee** — the fee when the client recalls an account after suit is filed, in percent of the balance due on the account at the time of recall.
- **Costs billed on recall** — whether the costs on a recalled matter are billed to the client.

## Rates and fees by programme

| Programme | Contingency rate | Suit fee | Demand letter fee | Forwarding fee | Dismissal fee | Recall-after-suit fee | Costs billed on recall |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Attorney Demand Program | 30.0% | $0.00 | $15.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | 0.0% | No |
| Small Claims Suit Program | 33.0% | $75.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $25.00 | 10.0% | Yes |
| Client-Advanced Cost Suit Program | 33.0% | $125.00 | $0.00 | $25.00 | $50.00 | 15.0% | Yes |
| Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program | 40.0% | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | 20.0% | Yes |
| Judgment Enforcement Program | 35.0% | $0.00 | $0.00 | $15.00 | $0.00 | 10.0% | Yes |
| Full-Service Litigation Program | 38.0% | $150.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $50.00 | 15.0% | Yes |

## Reading the schedule by charge

- Only the Attorney Demand Program charges per demand letter ($15.00 a letter).
- A forwarding fee per account is charged under the Client-Advanced Cost Suit Program ($25.00) and the Judgment Enforcement Program ($15.00); the other four programmes show $0.00.
- Suit fees are $75.00 (Small Claims Suit Program), $125.00 (Client-Advanced Cost Suit Program) and $150.00 (Full-Service Litigation Program); the remaining programmes show $0.00.
- The recall-after-suit fee runs from 0.0% (Attorney Demand Program) through 10.0%, 15.0% and 20.0% (Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program).
- Costs on a recalled matter are billed to the client under every programme except the Attorney Demand Program.

## Illustrations on hypothetical figures

The amounts below are invented inputs chosen only to show how the columns read; they are not fees or balances of any client.

1. *Contingency fee.* Hypothetical collections of $1200.00 on a forwarded matter under the Small Claims Suit Program carry a contingency fee of 33.0 percent of $1200.00, that is $396.00.
2. *Recall-after-suit fee.* A hypothetical account recalled after suit under the Full-Service Litigation Program with a balance due of $2400.00 at the time of recall carries a recall-after-suit fee of 15.0 percent of $2400.00, that is $360.00.
3. *Suit fee.* A suit filed under the Client-Advanced Cost Suit Program carries the $125.00 suit fee, which is non-refundable.
